{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA and refunded orders
df_clean = df[~((df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99) | (df['status'] == 'refunded'))]

# Compute conversion rates by channel
email_conv_rate = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_conv_rate = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
effect = email_conv_rate - paid_search_conv_rate

# Output only the required values using print()
print(f'Email conversion rate: {email_conv_rate}')
print(f'Paid_search conversion rate: {paid_search_conv_rate}')
print(f'Effect (email - paid_search): {effect}')"}
